camdrones.help.compact_fold_frame.summar: Folding camera frame – stays under 250 g
camdrones.help.compact_fold_frame.what.1: Closed shell · 250 mm · 52 g · folding arms
camdrones.help.compact_fold_frame.what.3: + about 30 min hover with the 2S smart battery
camdrones.help.compact_fold_frame.use.1: Fits: 14xx motors, 140–155 mm props, 20×20 nav board
camdrones.help.compact_fold_frame.use.2: Mounts: gimbal at the front, top
camdrones.help.tour_fold_frame.summary: Folding travel frame – the longest flights
camdrones.help.tour_fold_frame.what.1: Closed shell · 380 mm · 215 g · folding arms
camdrones.help.tour_fold_frame.what.2: + about 40 min hover with the 4S smart battery
camdrones.help.tour_fold_frame.what.3: + calm in wind thanks to 720 g
camdrones.help.cine_frame.summary: Large cine frame with landing gear – for the 360° gimbal
camdrones.help.cine_frame.what.1: Carbon arms · 695 mm · 1900 g · landing gear
camdrones.help.cine_frame.what.2: + carries the cine gimbal with interchangeable lenses
camdrones.help.cine_frame.what.4: − almost 4 kg: wide turns, long braking
camdrones.help.nav_fc_compact.summary: Flight controller with GPS – holds its position
camdrones.help.nav_fc_compact.what.1: Nav board · 2–4S · 12 A per motor · 8 g · 20×20
camdrones.help.nav_fc_compact.what.2: + GPS, compass and barometer on board
camdrones.help.nav_fc_compact.what.4: − no obstacle sensors at the front or sides
camdrones.help.nav_fc_pro.summary: Flight controller with GPS and sensors all around
camdrones.help.nav_fc_pro.what.1: Nav board · 3–6S · 45 A per motor · 28 g · 30×30
camdrones.help.nav_fc_pro.what.2: + obstacle sensors in six directions (15 m)
camdrones.help.nav_fc_pro.what.3: + stops in front of walls or climbs over them
camdrones.help.nav_fc_pro.use.1: For the tour and cine camera drones
camdrones.help.m1404_1600.summary: 1404 motor, 1600 KV – quiet and efficient in hover
camdrones.help.m1404_1600.what.2: + low KV for 6″ props: long hover
camdrones.help.m2008_500.what.2: + turns big props slowly: quiet and efficient
camdrones.help.m4114_320.what.2: + strong enough for the cine gimbal and lenses
camdrones.help.m4114_320.what.3: + cools well even at full throttle
camdrones.help.fold_6.summary: 6″ folding prop – quiet, folds for transport
camdrones.help.fold_6.use.1: For the compact camera drone, 14xx motors
camdrones.help.fold_9.summary: 9″ folding prop – efficient for long flights
camdrones.help.fold_9.use.1: For the tour camera drone, 2008 motors
camdrones.help.fold_15.summary: 15″ folding prop – lifts the cine drone
camdrones.help.fold_15.use.1: For the cine camera drone, 41xx motors
camdrones.help.cam_link_compact.summary: Digital camera link – clean picture, long range
camdrones.help.cam_link_compact.what.3: + more than twice the range of FPV video
camdrones.help.cam_link_compact.what.4: − 120 ms latency: too slow for racing
camdrones.help.cam_link_pro.summary: Digital camera link – best picture, longest range
camdrones.help.smart_2s_3850_lion.summar: 2S Li-Ion smart battery – about 30 min in the compact
camdrones.help.smart_4s_4240_hv.summary: 4S LiHV smart battery – about 40 min in the tour
camdrones.help.smart_4s_4240_hv.what.2: + the longest flight time of all classes
camdrones.help.smart_4s_4240_hv.what.3: − 300 g: only for the tour frame
camdrones.help.smart_6s_8560_hv.summary: Two 6S LiHV packs – about 26 min with almost 4 kg
camdrones.help.smart_6s_8560_hv.what.3: − 940 g: only for the cine frame
camdrones.help.gimbal_compact.summary: Stabilized camera – the horizon stays level
camdrones.help.gimbal_compact.what.2: + light: keeps the compact under 250 g
camdrones.help.gimbal_tour.summary: Stabilized camera with wide-angle and tele
camdrones.help.gimbal_tour.what.1: 3 axes · −90 to +30° tilt · 24 and 70 mm · 60 g
camdrones.help.gimbal_cine.summary: Cine camera that pans all the way around
camdrones.help.gimbal_cine.what.2: + lens bay for 24, 50 and 85 mm lenses
camdrones.help.gimbal_cine.what.3: + a second pilot can operate it
camdrones.help.gimbal_cine.what.4: − 420 g and 7 W: too heavy for the compact
camdrones.lens.hint.lens_24: Wide angle · for the lens bay of the cine gimbal
camdrones.lens.hint.lens_50: Normal lens · for the lens bay of the cine gimbal
camdrones.lens.hint.lens_85: Portrait tele · for the lens bay of the cine gimbal
camdrones.check.title: Check camera drone
camdrones.check.tooltip: Shows whether this build is a complete camera drone (Nav-FC, gimbal, battery, camera link) and names missing parts
camdrones.check.complete.hint: Everything a camera drone needs is fitted.
camdrones.check.incomplete: Not a complete camera drone yet
camdrones.check.incomplete.hint: Camera parts missing or wrong: %1$s of %2$s
camdrones.check.no_camera_frame: No camera frame fitted – with a camera frame the check names the matching parts.
camdrones.check.wrong.nav_fc: %s has no GPS: the drone flies like an FPV quad
